pages.title: Heat and Air
pages.text: The Crucible Furnace appears hot only while a paid batch is actively processing with input present, no ready output, and Bellows air remaining. Stored progress or air by itself is not heat.

pages.title: Pausing
pages.text: Losing airflow removes the hot appearance immediately but does not erase a paid batch. Restore airflow to continue. A completed output is treated as cooled and can be collected normally.
